wiki.title: David Martin (Michigan politician)
wiki.extract: David Martin (born May 12, 1961) is an American Republican politician from Michigan. He was elected to the Michigan House of Representatives from the 48th district in 2020, defeating incumbent representative Sheryl Kennedy. Prior to his role as state representative, Martin served on the Davison City Council, and was the director of Security and Facilities at the Pontiac Silver Dome.
